user.title: Connect to the Paradox PRT3
user.description: Pick the USB serial port, or enter a serial-over-network URL such as `socket://192.0.2.10:4000` (raw) or `rfc2217://192.0.2.10:4001`. The PRT3 must be in Home Automation mode with the ASCII protocol (section [016]). Discovery reads all labels and takes about half a minute.

data_description.codec: Character set of the names stored in the panel. Hungarian and other Central European panels use cp852.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the serial port.
error.no_response: The PRT3 did not answer. Check the baud rate and that the PRT3 is in Home Automation mode.
